method: All 55 tracks read against their existing bilingual lyrics. Phrase-level linguistic editing, comparison within the mixtape and earlier catalog, and external reference research. Existing lyric wording and audio timings preserved.

issues.detail: Awkward supplied wording; current English imposes an incomplete after-clause. Keep flagged for independent audio/transcript review, outside the interpretive annotation layer.

This strange wording may conceal a familiar phrase but no source confirms a replacement. Do not build an interpretation around straw hats or silently replace with 草台班子. Requires audio/source adjudication.
清先 is anomalous in this instruction. Do not build cultural claims around a guessed correction; preserve audio-review issue.
Water Curtain Cave identification secure; remaining grammar/object unresolved. Annotation now attaches only to the supported place name and does not interpret what is lifted.
Anomalous phrase remains unresolved; do not normalize to a guessed insult or identity. Needs audio review.

issues.text: 请了你最喜欢的固定资产
issues.detail: Fixed assets is a stable accounting phrase, but this full line’s referent is not clear. Removed annotation whose sole content was uncertainty; retained as research issue.
狗逼样的 differs from 狗逼养的 in the earlier repeated verse. Remove standalone quality-warning note; verify this sung phrase in an audio pass before normalizing.
牌太大了 likely concerns status/big shot (牌大) or oversized hand/stakes; English stakes chooses one. Annotation keeps both relevant domains; audio/context may establish 玩太大? Do not silently correct.
目是死不冥的 reshapes 死不瞑目; 冥 should normally be 瞑 in this meaning. English gets the intended idiom. Public note now discusses meaning rather than transcript workflow.
拿着我的头号招摇撞骗 is semantically awkward. 头衔 (title/status) is a plausible intended noun but needs audio verification; existing top billing translation should not be treated as settled.
手里攥着的是大结果 has an unclear handheld object; 大结果 does not yield an idiomatic reading. Remove placeholder note rather than invent weapon/prize; verify audio.
肉变菜了 permits literal prepared-food reading and slang 菜=unskilled beside 懒得玩了. Do not assert it definitely means becoming a novice or a specific game.
丛生到死 is an apparent homophone transcription typo for 从生到死. Existing English already translates from birth to death; Chinese correction can be made separately with provenance.
Prior formula attested in esports fan headline; public note now explains fit with Jackzebra’s verified name张正凯, without treating the track as being about Clearlove.
Repository temporarily returned404 during review. Both paired sayings and sexual gloss independently verified in the indexed PDF table, printedp338. Public citation now points directly to this PDF.
从都 is likely 从来都; 带耳钉 conventionally 戴耳钉. Existing meaning clear, do not devote a reader-facing annotation to spelling noise.
Mixed-English crack rn remains unclear; do not generate wordplay or intent from it without audio/editor verification.
建基层 is likely 建几层 (how many floors); English already takes this reading. Removed note dwelling on typo; unresolved audio verification remains.
Abrupt 她 in 我祈求好一辈子 天注定她就想死 not secure enough for close-reading pronoun claims. Leave lyrics/timing untouched.
Earlier 王中王 officially released2024, currenttape2026, lyric says去年. Do not infer exact recordingyear or claim directcalendar match; revisednote treats song-relative rhetorical time.
The song claims a self-funded20,000 freeperformance andtravelreimbursement. These are lyricclaims, not independentlydocumentedexpenses; notes explain rhetoricwithoutpresentingledgerasverifiedfact.

researchSources.label: Education Ministry: prohibition on paid tutoring by serving schoolteachers (2015)
researchSources.claims: The 2015 notice forbids schools and serving primary/secondary teachers from organizing or inducing pupils into paid supplementary classes; contextualizes the specific conflict in Sunshine, not an allegation about a real teacher.

researchSources.label: Ministry of Education idiom dictionary: 金玉其外，敗絮其中
researchSources.claims: Traces the saying to Liu Ji’s orange-seller parable, where handsome fruit with rotten interiors becomes criticism of officials with impressive standing and poor substance.

researchSources.label: Ministry of Education idiom dictionary: 對牛彈琴
researchSources.claims: Standard meaning addresses an uncomprehending audience; early story also concerns adapting one’s expression to an audience rather than only declaring that audience stupid.

researchSources.label: National Press and Publication Administration: anti-addiction gaming notice (2021)
researchSources.claims: 防沉迷 is an established policy/technical vocabulary concerning minors and online games; regulations existed before this song. The lyric’s question should not be presented as factual absence of law.

researchSources.label: Ministry of Education dictionary: 江湖
researchSources.claims: Beyond rivers/lakes, 江湖 names the environment/social world one inhabits and occurs in the expression about being unable to act freely within it.

researchSources.label: Tongling Daily: a primary school’s campaign against playground parodies (2007)
researchSources.claims: School head describes children replacing the schoolbag in 上学歌 with an explosives bag and school-destruction lyrics; documents both oral circulation and adult objection. Does not establish an originator.

researchSources.label: Nankai Youth League: jianbing rhyme (2017)
researchSources.claims: Article uses the yo/check-it-out/jianbing-set rhyme, supporting recognition of the rewritten hawker chant in Coffin Baby.

researchSources.label: Southern Weekly / Nanfang Plus: 嘻嘻不嘻嘻 (2024)
researchSources.claims: Documents the paired meme expression as a switch from laughter to not laughing.

researchSources.label: Ministry of Education idiom dictionary: 如魚得水
researchSources.claims: The idiom includes finding a suitable environment or compatible person; its fish-water image is not the duck of the official English title.

researchSources.label: Ministry of Education dictionary: 如膠似漆
researchSources.claims: Glue-and-lacquer image describes close, inseparable relationships; applying it to a pillow shifts that intimacy into a domestic object.

researchSources.label: Apple Music: 青楼 songwriting credits
researchSources.claims: Song credits identify jackzebra’s name as 张正凯; 凯 in 凯神 corresponds to Kai in his name, supporting the nickname explanation.
